QuestInfo.name: Naomi's Invitation 1
QuestInfo.0: #p9105002# seems to be holding a very fascinating event. I better go check it out.
QuestInfo.1: #p9105002# gave me all the information on the newest event that she planned. I should talk to her again in a bit.
QuestInfo.2: #p9105002# gave me an entrance ticket to participate in the event.

0.0: Hey there! Isn't it beautiful outside?
0.1: I am #p9105002#, a special event planner/event guide. I spend most of the time cooking up new events for the public, and this is when I get to see other people enjoy my hours of hard work!
0.2: So what do you think? If you have some free time on hand, you should definitely join this event. Interested?

yes.0: Awesome! Well, I need to print you a new ticket for entrance. Talk to me in a bit.

no.0: Oh, really. That's too bad. Like I said, if you have some time to burn, you should really try this.

1.0: Hey, you didn't wait too long, did you? Here is your ticket!
